text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I want to get super tough! I want to train a ton, become the strongest and the fastest, and then prove to the world that nobody can beat me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So let's do our best and get swole together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
